sources.entry: 5. Pro Prompting Tips on Reddit - Community-shared pro tips for Midjourney.

summary.name: Pro Prompting Tips (Midjourney)
summary.one_liner: A Reddit r/midjourney post listing ten community-shared tips for writing better Midjourney image prompts, credited to Ivan Mickovski.
keywords: how to write better ai art prompts
use_cases: controlling how strongly an image prompt influences output
removing unwanted elements from AI images with negative prompts
replicating an artist's style in Midjourney
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Reddit post collecting ten tips for prompting Midjourney. It explains that words near the start of a prompt carry more weight, and that commas act as soft blends while :: makes hard breaks. It describes using ::n weights and --iw for image prompts, where low values keep only small hints and high values nearly ignore the text. It notes that aspect ratio affects results, such as portraits producing extra faces in wide frames, and that naming a relevant artist or supplying reference images can steer style. It also suggests --no or negative weights to suppress unwanted elements.
notable: Explains commas versus :: hard breaks for concept blending
Covers --iw image weight and ::n text weights with concrete value effects
Recommends --no negative prompting for unwanted elements
caveats: Tips are community opinion from one user, not official Midjourney documentation
Long prompts can produce nonsense as well as good results, per the post
